parameters.content:
## 🧠 AI VoC → Backlog Synthesizer — Setup Checklist

1. **Webhook node**: Copy the Production URL and point your feedback source (Typeform webhook, in-app form, support tool) at it.
2. **OpenAI node**: Click the Credential dropdown and select or create your `OpenAi account` credential. Model defaults to gpt-4o-mini — swap if desired.
3. **Slack nodes (x2)**: Click the Credential dropdown and select or create your `slackOAuth2Api` credential, then choose the target Channel ID in each node's Channel field.
4. **Jira node**: Click the Credential dropdown and select or create your `jiraSoftwareCloudApi` credential, then pick your Project and Issue Type (e.g. Story/PBI) from the dropdowns.
5. **Notify node**: After activating, manually replace `YOUR-DOMAIN` inside the Slack 'Notify: Backlog Item Created' node text expression with your real Atlassian domain so the ticket link resolves.

No credentials are pre-linked in this file — every node below shows as unconfigured until you assign your own.

nodes.name: Feedback Intake Webhook
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: This is the trigger. Copy the 'Production URL' shown on this node and configure your feedback source (Typeform, in-app widget, support desk webhook, etc.) to POST JSON here. Method is POST, path is /voc-feedback.

nodes.name: Normalize Feedback Data
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Adjust the expressions if your source's payload shape differs (e.g. Typeform sends nested 'form_response.answers'). This node standardizes fields for the rest of the workflow — it doesn't need credentials.

values.content:
You are a Senior Product Analyst AI embedded in a product management pipeline. Analyze the raw customer feedback and return ONLY a strict JSON object — no markdown fences, no commentary, no extra text — with EXACTLY these keys:
- sentiment: one of "Positive", "Neutral", "Negative"
- urgency: one of "Low", "Medium", "High", "Critical"
- isFeatureRequest: boolean
- featureTitle: string, <=80 chars, empty string if not a feature request
- featureSummary: string, 2-3 sentences describing the requested capability and the user benefit, empty string if not applicable
- acceptanceCriteria: array of 3 short strings written in Given/When/Then style, empty array if not applicable
- suggestedLabels: array of up to 4 lowercase kebab-case strings
- category: one of "UX", "Performance", "Integration", "Pricing", "Bug", "Other"

Urgency should be "Critical" for data loss, security, or total blockers; "High" for major workflow breakage or churn risk; "Medium" for meaningful friction; "Low" for cosmetic or nice-to-have items.

nodes.name: AI: Extract Sentiment & Urgency
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: This node has no credential linked. Click the Credential dropdown and select or create your OpenAI credential. Model defaults to gpt-4o-mini for cost efficiency; upgrade to gpt-4o for higher-accuracy triage if your feedback volume is low. Do not edit the system prompt unless you also update the Code node that parses its output.

nodes.name: Parse AI JSON Output
nodes.notes: No configuration needed. Safely parses the AI's JSON response and re-merges it with the original customer fields. Falls back to a safe 'Low/Neutral' record if the model ever returns malformed JSON, so the workflow never crashes.

nodes.name: Is High Urgency?
nodes.notes: No configuration needed. Routes True (High/Critical urgency) to an immediate Slack alert; False continues silently to the feature-request check.

nodes.name: Alert: High-Urgency Feedback
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: This node has no credential linked. Click the Credential dropdown and select or create your Slack credential, then pick the Channel ID where urgent VoC alerts should land (e.g. #product-urgent-review).

nodes.name: Is Valid Feature Request?
nodes.notes: No configuration needed. True → drafts a Jira backlog item. False → logs a no-action response (e.g. praise, bug report, or ambiguous feedback that should not auto-create a PBI).

nodes.name: Create Backlog PBI
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: This node has no credential linked. Click the Credential dropdown and select or create your Jira credential. In the Project field pick your target Product Backlog project. In Issue Type pick your PBI/Story issue type. Description and labels are auto-populated from the AI analysis in Jira wiki markup.
